description: This is a Java test class for the UserCreatedShelfService, specifically testing the utility functions related to user-created bookshelves in the book project. It includes setup methods, test cases for retrieving books from custom shelves, and uses Spring Boot testing annotations.

classes.name: UserCreatedShelfUtilsTest
classes.description: Test class for utility functions related to user-created bookshelves, including setup and test cases for retrieving books from custom shelves.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data before each test, creating custom shelves and adding books.

methods.name: resetServices
methods.description: Clears all data from book and shelf services to ensure a clean state for tests.

methods.name: createSetOfBooks
methods.description: Creates a set of books with specified titles, associated with a predefined shelf and user-created shelf.

methods.name: createAndSaveBook
methods.description: Creates a new book with given title, predefined shelf, and user shelf, then saves it.

methods.name: addBooksToCustomShelves
methods.description: Adds books to custom shelves based on a predefined shelf.

methods.name: returnBooksSuccessfully
methods.description: Test case verifying books are correctly retrieved from a custom shelf.

methods.name: returnNoBooksIfNoBooksInCustomShelf
methods.description: Test case verifying that an empty set is returned when a custom shelf has no books.

methods.name: returnNoBooksForNonExistentCustomShelf
methods.description: Test case verifying that an empty set is returned when requesting books from a non-existent shelf.
